derivation:
by
  let f := (X.ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).hom; apply InducedCategory.hom_ext
  simpa [restrictOnNamedPreimage, restrictOnPreimage, f] using (PresheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_uniq f f (by simp) (𝟙 _) (by simp)).symm
explanation: After unfolding the restriction arrows, this is uniqueness of the lift of an open immersion through itself, with the identity as the competing lift. The current proof instead uses the library's factorization lemma and mono cancellation.
